description: Patch a monitor. Pass only fields you want to change; others are preserved.

alerts_wait.description: Minutes to wait before alerting. -1 disables, 0 is immediate.

check_frequency.description: Check interval in seconds. Sub-30s requires a business plan.

dns_expected_answer.description: Expected DNS answer to assert against.

domain_alert_days.description: Days before the domain registration expires to alert. -1 = never.

escalation_policy.description: UUID of an escalation policy to link.

group_id.description: Group to place the monitor in.

ip_version.description: IP version used to reach the target (default 4). 6 = checked over IPv6 only, for http/port/icmp, from the selected regions that have an IPv6 probe.

paused.description: Start the monitor in a paused state.

port.description: TCP port — required when protocol is "port".

regions.description: Probe region codes, e.g. ["us-east","eu-west"]. Use ["*"] for all.

required_keyword.description: Body must contain this keyword, else flagged down.

ssl_alert_days.description: Days before the TLS certificate expires to alert. -1 = never.

ssl_notify_on_change.description: Notify when the server starts serving a different certificate.

ssl_reminders.description: Also remind at 30, 15, 7, 3 and 1 days below the threshold.

uuid.description: UUID of the monitor to update.

name: update_monitor
title: Update monitor
